sections.title: An Aiken photographer *since 1995*
body: Scott has been a professional photographer since 1995. He has lived in Aiken most of his life, and he and his wife Laura are raising their family in the Aiken area as well.

Scott specializes in outdoor photography and enjoys natural light and real settings. He photographs weddings, bridal portraits, family portraits, senior portraits and much more, and enjoys the versatility of location shoots, including the beach.
